test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**strike**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses social inequality and the injustices faced by children working in various conditions.
 
• The appropriate verb should convey the impact or realization that the sight of these children does not immediately evoke a sense of injustice.
 
• **"Strike"** fits well as it means to have a strong impact or realization, which aligns with the idea of the injustice not immediately striking us.
 
• Other options such as "slap," "touch," and "force" do not convey the same meaning in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Slap" **means a physical strike, which does not convey the intended figurative meaning of an impact or realization.
 
• **"Touch" **refers to physical contact, which does not fit the context of a realization or impact on our conscience.
 
• **"Force" **implies a compulsion, which does not match the context of an immediate realization of injustice.
